headline: Swings to a profit as gold and copper sales climb
summary_short: Merdeka Copper Gold's Q2 FY2026 basic EPS was 0.0018 IDR, down 25.0% from 0.0024 IDR in the prior quarter but a swing to positive from a loss of 0.0004 IDR a year earlier.
summary_long: Basic EPS was 0.0018 IDR in Q2 FY2026, down about 25% q/q from 0.0024 IDR, but a swing to a per-share profit versus a 0.0004 IDR per-share loss a year earlier. No revenue, margin, or cash-position figures are available from verified shard data for this kpi-only pass. The shard's per-share unit label carries an unusually small magnitude relative to a typical per-share figure for this issuer; presented as stored, not independently corrected.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. This Indonesian issuer has no edgarCik and no irSources reports_page_url; the shard's own sourceLink is a Google-search fallback (kind=fallback), not a filing. WebSearch #1 located the company's own 2Q26 Activities Report press release on merdekacoppergold.com (its own IR domain); fetch #1 (WebFetch) of that PDF and fetch #2 of the fuller MDKA_Q2_2026_Quarterly_Activities_Report_Final.pdf both returned raw undecodable PDF binary, no extractable text via the sanctioned tools (extract-doc-text.mjs is HTML-only). WebSearch #1's own result summary, however, surfaced specific sourced figures directly attributable to the press release (Q2 2026 product sales of $775.6M; TB Gold produced 24,567 oz gold at cash cost $1,743/oz and AISC $2,486/oz; EMAS subsidiary produced 15,594 oz gold + 29,796 oz silver at cash cost $1,183/oz and AISC $1,754/oz; copper sales of 1,924 tonnes at ASP $5.83/lb generating $24.7M unaudited revenue; cash and equivalents of $683M plus $252.6M undrawn debt facilities as of 2026-06-30) — these are used for the Step 3b extendedMetrics pass (gold production, AISC, copper production; confidence 0.8, flagged as search-engine-summarized rather than independently read verbatim) but are NOT folded into the KPI ledger above, which remains sourced solely from resolver shard data (EPS only) per kpi-only discipline; revenue/production/cash figures are not in the resolver's kpis object for this event and so are not asserted as deltas here. EPS q/q delta computed normally (-25.0%); y/y comparison is a sign swing from a negative prior-year value (-0.0004) to a positive actual (0.0018), so delta_basis is set to 'none' rather than compute a meaningless percentage off a near-zero/negative base — the swing itself is described in prose instead. No drivers or guidance were assessed per kpi-only depth rules.
